title: Named broadcast markers are refused before their actual axis can be checked

evidence.events: campaign-evidence/runs/open_cake-1/events; provider_turn_completed and candidate_rejected; evaluator_request retained by run_fault

observation: Retained 005 assigns a32_rows=lm.broadcast(a32_k, axis=0); the frontend rejects the temporary as an alias before the existing shape verifier can diagnose its wrong axis. Norm tasks 023/024/026 also repeatedly confuse broadcast axes, power-of-two vector spans and masked tails. Static probes for masked whole-row h1536/h2048/h7168 already assess and lower with existing tiled program coordinates, so those cases do not establish missing IR.
proposed_change: Allow a named broadcast construction marker to erase into the existing canonical operation, leaving standalone Buffer aliases and indexed-view aliases refused. Explain retained broadcast axes and masked tiled program coordinates in diagnostics. No new IR primitive or pass; existing verifier checks remain authoritative.
principles: P1/P3: erase construction-only naming into existing canonical operations. P4/P5/P7: keep typed shape and lifetime checks with their existing owners. P6: exact regression and unchanged Corpus Gate. P2/P8: no hidden lowering or hardware change.
